# ForgeSuite Studio

> Zero-backend, privacy-first micro-SaaS, DevSecOps, and Web3 security tool portfolio by youthmy11-ai. Offers 9 client-side browser applications (including WalletLens 6-chain EVM & Solana portfolio/EIP-7702/Safe inspector, TokenGuard live EVM & Solana contract risk scanner, and BrandGuard 8-TLD domain & developer handle checker), 2 open-core desktop/browser tools (AutoShorts Studio and WebLead & Table Extractor), a zero-dependency Node 20+ MCP Server (v1.3.0, 8 tools — 1-command run: `npx --yes github:youthmy11-ai/youthmy11-ai.github.io`), 5 autonomous A2A + x402 cloud agents, and an All-Access Lifetime Pro Bundle ($15–$49 pricing, zero subscriptions, zero server uploads) with instant client-side on-chain BSC USDT (BEP20) and Solana SPL USDC auto-unlock plus TRC20, Binance Pay, and PayPal checkout.

ForgeSuite Studio is designed for solo founders, independent freelancers, AI engineers, content creators, and Web3 builders who want fast local-first software without recurring subscriptions or cloud tracking.

- **Client-Side Privacy Guarantee**: All 9 web applications run 100% in local browser memory with zero ForgeSuite backend servers, zero analytics, and zero data uploads. QR codes are rendered offline via pure ES module JavaScript (`assets/qr.js`), CryptoBill invoices share state via client-only `#inv=` URL fragments, BrandGuard queries Google DoH + CORS RDAP directly, and TokenGuard / WalletLens query CORS-friendly public JSON-RPC nodes directly from the browser.
- **Transparent Lifetime Pricing**: 9 web applications provide generous free tiers immediately; Pro lifetime licenses are $15 (CryptoBill Forge Pro — also unlocks BrandGuard 25-Brand Agency Matrix & WalletLens 25-Wallet Treasury Watchlist), $19 (AutoShorts Studio Pro), $15 (WebLead & Table Extractor Pro), or $35 for the All-Access Bundle (compare at $49, save $14 — unlocks every Pro tool plus TokenGuard 25-token Batch Watchlist, BrandGuard 25-Brand Matrix & WalletLens 25-Wallet Watchlist with JSON/CSV exports).
- **Instant Crypto & PayPal Checkout**: Automatic client-side RPC verification on BNB Smart Chain (`USDT BEP20`) and Solana Mainnet (`SPL USDC`) issues deterministic checksummed offline license keys (`FS-PRO-...`) in seconds. Manual rails (`USDT TRC20`, `Binance Pay`, `PayPal`) are supported via `youthmy11@gmail.com`.

## Live Browser Applications (100% Client-Side)

- [ForgeSuite Studio Hub & Storefront](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/): Catalog of all 13 tools and bundle offerings, interactive CryptoBill QR sandbox, transparent pricing table, and instant on-chain license verifier.
- [CryptoBill Forge](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/cryptobill.html): Free + $15 Pro lifetime serverless crypto & PayPal freelance invoice builder with A4 PDF export, deterministic offline QR codes, and shareable `#inv=` client payment links.
- [TokenGuard Risk Scanner](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/tokenaudit.html): Free unlimited single-token scanner + Pro 25-token Batch Watchlist (`$35` Bundle) auditing live EVM (`Base`, `Ethereum`, `BSC`, `Arbitrum`) bytecode opcodes (`SELFDESTRUCT`, `DELEGATECALL`), EIP-1967/1167 proxies, honeypot tax selectors, and Solana (`SPL` & `Token-2022`) `mintAuthority`, `freezeAuthority`, `permanentDelegate`, `transferFeeConfig`, and holder concentration (supports direct query deep-links `?chain=solana&mint=...` and `?chain=base&address=...`).
- [Solana Token-2022 Risk & Permanent Delegate Scanner](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/solana-token-2022-scanner.html): Specialized Solana `TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb` extension & authority scanner explaining `PermanentDelegate` seizure backdoors, `TransferFeeConfig` 100% fee traps, `TransferHook` CPI honeypots, `FreezeAuthority`, and Top-10 holder concentration with 1-click live mainnet deep-links and `solana_mint_risk_scan` MCP snippets.
- [EVM EIP-1967 Proxy, SELFDESTRUCT & Honeypot Bytecode Scanner](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/evm-proxy-honeypot-scanner.html): Specialized EVM bytecode disassembler & storage-slot inspector across Base, Ethereum, BSC, and Arbitrum explaining unverified `DELEGATECALL` proxy traps, EIP-1167 minimal clones, PUSH-aware `SELFDESTRUCT` disassembly, and mutable sell-tax/blacklist selectors with 1-click deep-links and `evm_token_risk_scan` MCP snippets.
- [BrandGuard Launch Scanner](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/brandcheck.html): Free instant single-brand + 4 Smart Name Variations scanner + Pro 25-Brand Agency Matrix (`$15` Pro / `$35` Bundle) checking 8 domain TLDs (`.com`, `.io`, `.ai`, `.dev`, `.app`, `.org`, `.net`, `.xyz`) via Google DoH (`NS` + `A`) + CORS RDAP alongside `npm`, `PyPI`, `GitHub`, `Bluesky`, and US Apple iOS App Store collisions (`0–100` Launch Readiness Score, CSV/JSON client export, ScopeGuard/CryptoBill handoff, `?brand=...` deep-links supported).
- [USPTO Trademark, 8-TLD Domain & Developer Brand Checker](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/uspto-trademark-domain-brand-checker.html): Specialized AI/SaaS startup brand collision scanner & technical guide covering 8 domain TLDs (`.com`, `.ai`, `.io`, `.dev`, `.app`, `.org`, `.net`, `.xyz`), `npm`/`PyPI`/`GitHub` package registries, Apple App Store / Google Play title screening, and federal USPTO Class 009/042 trademark checks with 1-click `brandcheck.html?brand=...` deep-links, `brand_domain_handle_scan` MCP snippets, and `@forge-brand-checker` (`$0.35 USDC`) A2A handoff.
- [WalletLens Multi-Chain Portfolio, EIP-7702 & Gnosis Safe Inspector](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/walletcheck.html): Free instant 6-chain wallet inspector + Pro 25-Wallet Treasury & Counterparty Watchlist (`$15` Pro / `$35` Bundle) across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, BSC, Polygon, and Solana Mainnet via CORS-clean RPCs — native gas, `USDC`/`USDT`/`DAI`/`PYUSD` holdings, tx nonces, EIP-7702 (`0xef0100...`) delegations, Gnosis Safe `M-of-N` signers, pure-JS Ed25519 Solana ATA derivation, latest 10 Solana signatures, CSV/JSON reconciliation exports, and 1-click CryptoBill/ScopeGuard handoffs (`?address=...` deep-links supported).
- [EIP-7702 Delegation & Gnosis Safe Multisig Checker](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/eip-7702-delegation-gnosis-safe-checker.html): Specialized smart-account & treasury forensics guide explaining post-Pectra/Prague/Isthmus `EIP-7702` (`0xef0100...`) bytecode delegation indicators, `Gnosis Safe` `M-of-N` threshold & owner verification, and 6-chain EVM + Solana balance reconciliation with 1-click `walletcheck.html?address=...` deep-links, `multi_chain_wallet_scan` MCP snippets, and `@wallet-activity-scanner` (`$0.15 USDC`) A2A handoff.
- [TokenCost Lab](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/tokencalc.html): Free ($0) offline LLM token counter and monthly AI agent API budget calculator comparing frontier models (GPT-5, Claude 4.5, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek V3) with 1-click CryptoBill quote export.
- [JSON2Sheet & PII Masker](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/json2sheet.html): Free ($0) offline nested JSON flattener to RFC-4180 CSV, TSV, and GitHub Markdown tables with Excel formula-injection protection and instant email/IP/token PII redaction.
- [ScopeGuard SOW Builder](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/sowbuilder.html): Free ($0) offline freelance, AI engineering, and Web3 audit Statement of Work generator with 100%-balanced milestone splits and 1-click CryptoBill USDT invoicing.
- [Calldata Lens](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/txdecode.html): Free ($0) offline Ethereum & BSC EVM hex calldata decoder for ERC-20 transfers, infinite `MAX_UINT256` approval risk alerts, EIP-2612 permits, ERC-4626 vaults, and Safe multisig payloads.
- [EnvShield Secret Scanner](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/envshield.html): Free ($0) offline `.env`, JSON, and AI transcript secret scanner & redactor detecting OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, AWS, Telegram, JWT, DB URI passwords, EVM private keys, and high-entropy credentials.
- [ForgeSuite MCP Server (v1.3.0 — Official MCP Registry Active)](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/mcp.html): Verified on the Official MCP Registry (`io.github.youthmy11-ai/forgesuite-mcp` · `https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers?search=forgesuite`). Free ($0) zero-dependency Node 20+ JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio MCP server (`npx --yes github:youthmy11-ai/youthmy11-ai.github.io`, `.mcpb` bundle `https://github.com/youthmy11-ai/youthmy11-ai.github.io/releases/download/v1.3.0/forgesuite-mcp.mcpb`, and 1-click VS Code MCP install) for VS Code, Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, and Windsurf exposing 8 tools: `envshield_scan`, `calldata_decode`, `tokencost_estimate`, `cryptobill_quote`, `evm_token_risk_scan`, `solana_mint_risk_scan`, `brand_domain_handle_scan`, and `multi_chain_wallet_scan`.
